$comment: Gzipped byte budgets per app. Two kinds of key: glob patterns, matched against paths relative to the app's dist/ directory (* does not cross a path separator); and $-prefixed aggregate totals ($total:js, $total:css), which sum gzipped bytes across every measured file of that extension regardless of name. $total exists because most bundle weight lives in bundler-generated chunk names (module-federation virtual modules, vendor splits) that no glob can name stably; a total is rename-proof where a pattern is not. Any key beginning with $ is reserved for a recognised total (currently only $total:js and $total:css) -- it can never be used as a literal glob pattern, and an app whose budgets contain any other $-prefixed key (a typo such as $total:jss, or a plausible future addition that was never wired up) fails loudly naming the bad key, whether or not that app was built. Source maps (*.map) are excluded from every measurement, including the totals -- they are verified separately by verify:sourcemaps. An app directory that is not present is skipped (deleting the reference half is supported), but a run that measures no app at all fails, and so does a $total that summed zero files. Regenerate the numbers with: pnpm build && node scripts/check-bundle-size.mjs --report. Rule for setting a budget from a measurement: round the measured gzipped byte count up to the next whole kilobyte (1 KB = 1024 bytes, i.e. ceil(bytes / 1024) * 1024), then add 10 percent headroom (* 1.1), then round any fractional byte up. Measured 2026-08-30 from a forced build (entry patterns): storefront index.js 4814B -> 5120B -> 5632B; storefront css 4761B -> 5120B -> 5632B; shell index.js 4220B -> 5120B -> 5632B; shell css 4444B -> 5120B -> 5632B; console index.js 4350B -> 5120B -> 5632B; console css 4510B -> 5120B -> 5632B. All six land in the same 4-5KB band by coincidence of the apps sharing near-identical entry/shell scaffolding, not because the rule was fudged to match. Re-measured 2026-08-31 at f2f1e24, after M6 wired @sentra/i18n, @sentra/plugin-errors and @sentra/flags into the reference apps: console index.js 5898B, which exceeded its 5632B budget by 266B, so that one key is raised by the rule above to 6144B -> 6759B (ceil(5898 / 1024) * 1024 = 6144, * 1.1 = 6758.4, fractional byte up). This is the milestone's deliverable rather than a regression: console is the app that received all three packages, and its entry chunk carries their runtime plus the shared @sentra/ui message catalogue that apps/console/src/main.ts:127 installs. Console ships no catalogue of its own -- main.ts:117-118 says so -- so the growth is the three plugin runtimes and the catalogue object, not app-specific translation data. A locale-side code fix was measured rather than assumed, and it does not close the gap: uiMessages (packages/ui/src/i18n/index.ts:16) is one object literal { en, id: idTyped }, so console cannot tree-shake the Indonesian half it never selects (locale and fallbackLocale are both fixed at en). Narrowing the install to { en: uiMessages.en } saves 5 bytes and leaves the Indonesian strings in the chunk, because referencing the module still constructs the whole object. Removing id from uiMessages at source -- the most aggressive locale-side fix, and one that would require changing a shared platform package on behalf of one consumer -- brings the entry to 5764B, still 132B over the old 5632B budget. id.json gzips to 254B standalone but its marginal cost inside the chunk is 134B, because en's identical key names already prime the compression dictionary. The second candidate, curating the catalogue's contents rather than its locales, is capped below that: en.json is also a single object literal, and console's own views reference only DataTable, so at most four of seven keys are in question against a whole-locale cost of 134B. This is a measured bound on the two available fixes, not a claim that no other fix could exist; the one remaining named option, lazy per-locale loading, is excluded from M6 by ADR 0011:82-83. See docs/adr/0009-gate-policy.md for the full derivation. Exactly one key moved; every other budget still passes on its 2026-08-30 number. The other two entry chunks grew too and still fit -- shell index.js 4220B -> 5178B, storefront index.js 4814B -> 5156B -- which leaves both within 500B of the same 5632B budget, so the next change to either entry should expect to re-measure rather than assume headroom. ADR 0009 records why a raise is a documented event and not a silent edit. Measured 2026-08-30 from the same build (totals, .map excluded): storefront $total:js 308816B -> 309248B -> 340173B; storefront $total:css 4761B -> 5120B -> 5632B (one css file, same as the entry pattern); shell $total:js 282795B -> 283648B -> 312013B; shell $total:css 4444B -> 5120B -> 5632B; console $total:js 284512B -> 284672B -> 313140B; console $total:css 4510B -> 5120B -> 5632B. Shell's $total:js includes an MSW browser chunk reached only via a dynamic import() behind a dead branch in a production build (registry/boot.ts:71) -- it is emitted but never fetched, so it inflates this budget but is not a runtime cost; if that dead code is ever removed, re-measure and lower shell's $total:js.
